name: open-repo-wiki
description: Generate a documentation wiki for any repository with any AI model — local (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, GGUF in-process) or online (Zhipu GLM, Moonshot Kimi, any OpenAI-compatible API) — and export it to PDF.
optionalDependenciesNote: The wiki generator itself has ZERO runtime dependencies (Node >= 18 built-in fetch). Optional packages: 'node-llama-cpp' enables the llamacpp provider (direct GGUF inference); 'playwright' + 'pdf-lib' enable export.js (PDF export). Install none of them with: npm install --omit=optional
